_comment: Maps git author emails (lowercase) to GitHub @handles for scripts/docs/bump-last-validated.mjs. Repo is public: put only public noreply/bot addresses in `emailToHandle`. Personal addresses go into `emailSha256ToHandle` as sha256 hex of the lowercased email (node -e "console.log(require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update('<lowercased email>').digest('hex'))"), never in plain text.
